structured_output.world_model:
W5 (contrarian), after E056. The tip is still E049 at 5.198 s. Seeds 0–2 accuracy has read 0.7535 and 0.7552 across two builds.

1. Rebuild noise. A rebuild changes kernel choice, so it acts like re-rolling each seed's chaotic trajectory. I expect it to reshuffle seeds without shifting the mean. The SD of 3-seed means across builds (~0.2 pp) fits a per-seed SD of ~0.25 pp with roughly uncorrelated per-seed differences. So σ_build for a 20-seed mean should be ≤0.06 pp. That would refute H4.5.1 and loosen the H4.6 gate. On one build, a 3-seed result is a coin flip around the population mean. Time reproduces to about ±0.03 s per build. E050 showed that no-cudagraphs or a pinned cache costs no time; my forecast that it would be slower was a miss.

2. Elementwise traffic is a bigger lever than I priced. E056 (ReLU swap) cut 4.7% of time (4.95 s), which I had refuted. H6.5 holds: the fused BN/GELU kernels in the backward are a large share of the 32 px step, and a cheaper activation backward pays. Its accuracy cost on seeds 0–2 was ~−0.15 pp, within noise of the tip. Priced at the dial (~1–1.5 s/pp), ReLU plus a small epoch top-up (+0.25 epoch, ~+0.12 s) probably beats the tip by ~0.1 s. That is the best unexploited combination. H6.5.2 (BN stats on a subset) and H6.5.3 now deserve more prior.

3. Muon renormalizes filters every step, so filter wd is inert. The update norm is also fixed, so a filter's ||ΔW||/||W|| simply follows its LR schedule. H7.1.1's filter curves will reproduce the schedule and cannot separate E028 from E037. Only gradient-norm and BN-bias curves carry information.

4. Freezes. Annealed freezes save 1.5–2× their FLOP share (E028, E046). Their cost scales roughly linearly with the LR integral removed while downstream groups still learn, with no cliff:
   - E037 (60%): −0.4 pp;
   - E055 (71%): −0.15 pp;
   - E053 (group 2 at 85%): ~−0.2 pp on reused seeds.
   No remaining freeze dose beats the dial.

5. Steps carry accuracy; early pixels do not. E026 and E033 were free. Step cuts (E031, E040, E041, E048, E054, E055) all trade at or below the dial.

6. Closed by reading the code:
   - BN scale already has requires_grad=False, so I092 needs no run.
   - TrainingData has only fine labels, so H1.8 is blocked; an external mapping table would count as external data.

7. The end-game (averaging, LS, LR floor) is at a local optimum: E025, E030, E032 and E044 all hurt.

8. Paths to a faster tip:
   - (a) Re-keep E052 (4.99 s) or E046 (5.08 s) under a derived gate. Their population means are probably ~0.7515–0.753, which clears the 0.75 official bar with high probability. The binding constraint is the single-build seeds 0–2 ≥ 0.753 check, which passes only ~45% of the time.
   - (b) ReLU plus a top-up, stacked with E052's selection.

9. On the PCIe judge, expect times 5–10% higher. Accuracy is unchanged beyond the reshuffle.

Unsure:
- whether the 13–32 deficits were winner's curse (I lean ≤0.1 pp);
- whether the rebuild noise has a correlated component;
- ReLU's true population cost;
- whether a smaller early batch (E045) beats the dial.

forecasts.reason: Rebuilds reshuffle seeds roughly independently, so the 20-seed means should differ by under 0.06 pp with near-zero correlation in the per-seed differences.
E052/E053 fresh means should be about 0.7515–0.7525, which passes P(official ≥0.75) ≥0.9 with a small σ_build. Whether the one-build seeds 0–2 check passes is a coin flip.
−0.25 epoch should cost ~0.06–0.12 pp, so the SE of the difference (~0.08 pp) leaves the dial price unresolved between 0.7 and 1.5 s/pp.
TrainingData has only fine labels, so the idea is blocked and does not run; the numbers are a tip re-measure.
BatchNorm.__init__ already sets weight.requires_grad=False, so H1.5.10 closes by reading the code.
It saves only ~33 cheap 20 px stem dgrad steps (~0.03 s, inside the build spread). The bias is probably done early, so the accuracy change should be ~0, which ~0.08 pp noise cannot confirm.
Muon renormalizes weights and fixes the update norm, so filter ||ΔW||/||W|| tracks the LR schedule and cannot separate E028 from E037.

cruxes: Is the rebuild noise uncorrelated across seeds (σ_build of a 20-seed mean ≤0.06 pp)? If so, a derived gate can re-keep E052/E053/E046 and the 0.7545 thresholds were over-priced.
What does ReLU (E056, −4.7% time) cost on fresh seeds 33–52? If ≤0.1 pp, ReLU plus a 0.25-epoch top-up, stacked with E052's selection, is the fastest route under 5.0 s.
What is the true post-freeze dial price (I090)? It decides whether every remaining per-step cut, such as BN-stat subsets and ReLU, beats simply trimming epochs.
